newsitem.title: USA: Banco Ganadero Q3 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Banco Ganadero Q3 net falls.

text.p: (All data above in millions of pesos)

NOTE: Q3 net interest income: 97,831 million pesos vs 65,497 million pesos. Q3 Net interest income after provision for loans and accounts accounts receivable: 78,983 million pesos vs 54,342 million pesos.
Nine-month net interest income: 271.18 billion pesos vs 182.24 billion pesos. Nine-month net interest income after the provision for loan losses: 222.17 billion vs 146.35 billion.
Q3 foreign exchange: loss 742 million pesos vs gain 6.39 billion pesos.
Total assets at Sept 30: 3.510 trillion pesos vs 2.823 trillion pesos.
Total interest earning assets at Sept 30: 2.653 billion pesos vs 2.011 billion pesos.
Total interest bearing liabilities at Sept 30: 1.786 billion pesos vs 1.653 billion pesos.
